explanation: This is van Dantzig's theorem for locally compact, totally disconnected groups. Mathlib only has the compact case: IsTopologicalGroup.exist_openSubgroup_sub_clopen_nhds_of_one (Topology/Algebra/OpenSubgroup.lean), which needs CompactSpace G and a clopen neighbourhood of 1, and ProfiniteGrp.exist_openNormalSubgroup_sub_open_nhds_of_one (ClopenNhdofOne.lean), which also needs CompactSpace. Getting the locally compact version from these takes a real argument: the library's proof first builds a compact clopen set and then uses its own exists_compact_subset_of_compact_open. Searched: every TotallyDisconnectedSpace result under Topology/Algebra; theorem and lemma names containing openSubgroup, vanDantzig or compactOpen; the files using LocallyCompactSpace, including Group/CompactOpen.lean; and the Nonarchimedean folder. No locally compact version was found.
